title: Smoky Black Bean Soup with Lime and Coriander
summary: A hearty Mexican-inspired vegan black bean soup with smoky paprika, cumin, fresh lime and coriander. It is warming, bright and ideal for a satisfying lunch.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and red bell pepper with a pinch of the salt, then cook for 6–8 minutes until softened and the onion is translucent.
Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and chilli powder. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant, taking care not to let the garlic burn.
Add the canned tomatoes, black beans, vegetable stock, remaining salt and black pepper. Stir well, bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 18–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and the soup has slightly thickened.
Blend about half the soup with a stick blender, leaving plenty of whole beans for texture. Alternatively, mash some beans against the side of the pan with a spoon.
Stir in the lime juice and most of the coriander. Taste and adjust with more salt, pepper or lime if needed.
Ladle into bowls and finish with the remaining coriander. Serve hot.
